canonical_title: Major drugmakers disclose concrete AI-assisted drug discovery timeline reductions
treatment: Follow up only for independently validated clinical outcomes, new quantified results, or official trial milestones.
known_facts: Reuters published new interviews at 2026-11-20 11:02 UTC.
Sanofi says AI-assisted development of lunsekimig saved at least one year.
Novo Nordisk says design/test cycles fell from about eight to three and each cycle from eight to four weeks.
Clinical success rates and approval time improvements are unproven.
reinclude_only_if: New primary data independently validates outcome or timeline.
New material clinical trial results or safety evidence.
notes: New reporting on quantified pharma operational outcomes, not a new Anthropic model release.
